sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say “in” a month, add *-ban* or *-ben*, the same ending as in *a konyhában*. Look at the last vowel of the word: a back vowel (*á*, *u*) gives *-ban*, an *e* gives *-ben*. Eight months take *-ban*. Only *szeptember*, *október*, *november* and *december* end in *e* and take *-ben*. *Október* has an *o* and an *ó* in it, but its last vowel is *e*, so it is *októberben*. *Április* ends in the neutral vowel *i*, so the *á* before it decides: *áprilisban*.

items.english: In January we rest at home.
In June we walk in the park.
In December we cook in the kitchen.
When do you all study? – In September.

sections.content: A month needs no word for “in” besides the ending: *júniusban*, not a separate word. Say the ending only once, on the month.
